headline: On last trading day, Indian markets closed higher led by IT stocks, extending weekly gains.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 19 October.

why: IT stocks led the gains, driving benchmark indices higher during the last trading session.
A strengthening rupee provided additional support to Indian market sentiment.
Strong buying momentum and positive FII flows helped Sensex and Nifty extend their rally.
Positive brokerage commentary and target price hikes boosted confidence in select banking and industrial stocks.
whatHappening: PNB received target price hikes, while Crompton Greaves and Federal Bank stayed under bullish brokerage focus.
Market experts recommended Mphasis, HAL, and Indian Hotel as top stocks to watch for Monday, October 19.
Sensex had rallied over 1,500 points during the week with Nifty approaching the 23,000 mark.
Markets remain closed on Sunday, October 18 for the weekend and will resume trading on October 19.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices closed higher in the last trading session, boosted by gains in IT stocks and a strengthening rupee.
Brokerage houses maintained a bullish outlook on select banking, consumer, and defence stocks ahead of the new trading week.
Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen for trading on Monday, October 19.
